title: Minimal Dataset Size Threshold for Emergent Misalignment

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Extremely clear causal chain: determine the minimum data needed to trigger emergent misalignment, directly quantifying the threat from small-scale finetuning. Result immediately informs policy on finetuning API access controls and technical safeguards for dataset size thresholds.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Open-source code and models (Qwen, model-organisms-for-EM) are readily available. A single-GPU sweep over dataset sizes is straightforward. Beginners can follow existing training scripts and vary one parameter. Some care needed with hyperparameter matching across runs.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single independent variable (dataset size), single dependent variable (misalignment rate), single deliverable (dose-response curve). Extremely well-scoped for 30 hours. No ambiguity about when the experiment is done.
